steps.name: Perceber
steps.task: Restate the piece: its goal, its reader, its language, the primary keyword and the search intent behind it (informational, navigational, commercial or transactional), the secondary keywords, and every deliverable (text, images, sizes, where each file goes).

steps.name: Plano de pesquisa
steps.task: Before any search, fix the research plan: the exact queries in the order they will run, derived only from the brief, and the source rules. Run nothing yet. The same brief must always give the same plan.

steps.name: Pesquisar
steps.task: Run exactly the planned queries, in order, and no others. For every fact the piece may use, record one line: the claim, the exact sentence that supports it, its link and the date it was read. Hand back every link read; each must open.

steps.name: Verificar
steps.task: Keep a claim only when a primary source states it, or two independent sources agree on it; numbers and dates must match exactly. List the kept claims with their sources, and every dropped claim with the reason. Nothing dropped may appear in the piece.

steps.name: Escrever
steps.task: Write the piece into its file from the verified claims only, citing each fact where it is used. Hand back the file and the SEO sheet: title (at most 60 characters), meta description (150 to 160), slug, H1, the outline of H2 and H3, where the primary keyword appears, internal and external links, the schema.org type, and the alt text of every image.

steps.name: Imagens
steps.task: Produce or improve every image the deliverables ask for, with scripts/images.py beside the skill: crop to the needed ratio, resize to the largest width shown, compress to WebP or AVIF within the weight budget. Report each image's size and bytes before and after. No image is generated by a paid service without the user's yes.

steps.name: Rever
steps.task: Read the finished piece against the SEO sheet and the verified claims. Every number, date, name and quotation in the text maps to a verified claim; every image has its alt text and stays within budget. List each check with pass or the fix made.
